amendments.preserve: Forbid Gate/client/matching/inference execution in the passive kernel.
amendments.proposed_text: The skeleton now evolves only as passive, attributed semantic persistence. Runtime source admission, transport orchestration and CRM handoff belong to the optional integration owner admitted under SK-A01. No mandatory addon may gain a dependency merely to install this capability; default business activation remains off.

amendments.preserve: Specification is normative; observation is attributed; UUIDs remain immutable.
amendments.proposed_text: Approved observation content is superseded by a new version rather than overwritten. Source, method, evidence state, validity and rule/model revision remain explicit. Inferred observations do not constitute verified current supply or demand. General profile changes cannot rewrite approved opportunity snapshots.

amendments.preserve: Matching remains Gate/CEG authority; no ambiguous conversion helpers.
amendments.proposed_text: Native CRM opportunity is the sole commercial attempt. SupplyOpportunity and BuyerDemand are derived/current-fact representations, not independent trading pipelines. Native-source binding and approved material evidence govern publication. Prospect-owned identities reuse the existing CRM facility/material mechanism; a partner must not be invented to satisfy persistence. Independent commercial menus/actions are retired or restricted while historical records/UUIDs are preserved.

amendments.section: Append narrowly superseding amendment after TASK-031
amendments.preserve: Explicit command, dry-run, batching, idempotence, no install-hook and ambiguous conversion denial.
amendments.proposed_text: The TASK-031 specification-only slice remains the default. Supply/demand may be processed only under a separately admitted source contract, exact reviewed batch/mapping, real persistence adapter, verified recovery and operator execution grant. Profile/capability/historical-record-to-current-availability inference remains forbidden. Counts called created/updated mean committed ORM effects; planning intent is reported separately. The blanket guard is not removed without source-aware replacement and consumer tests.

amendments.preserve: Supply and demand remain separate peer protocols.
amendments.proposed_text: Source refs, revision, material/quantity/time semantics, evidence classes and compatibility must match admitted active consumers. A field-name or enum change is a versioned contract revision, not a caller-side convenience. No combined supply/demand discriminator and no transport identity fields in domain payloads.

amendments.preserve: Only plasticos_gate owns SDK invocation and Gate mediation.
amendments.proposed_text: Builders are not runtime integration by themselves. Their exact payload and result shapes must be bound to the deployed handler version and source contract. A source-aware optional publisher calls the admitted mapper after source commit; signed acknowledgements and node/edge readback close the operation. Match, sync, inference and gap assessment are distinct actions/permissions. Existing direction versus match_direction divergence must be resolved at the contract owner before connection.

amendments.preserve: Specification behavior, dual approval and no local intelligence restoration remain unchanged.
amendments.proposed_text: Read-authority cutover is separate from backfill and publication. Supply/demand remain blocked until their exact family/operation contracts and proof gates are admitted. Controls must guard actual runtime read/write/dispatch consumers, not merely classify configuration. Operator grants are scoped to source/release/tenant/operation and rechecked for queued work. Disable preserves evidence and cannot leave stale marketable supply silently eligible.

amendments.section: Decision / semantic clarification, not unversioned identifier rename
amendments.preserve: CEG owns matching; existing public identifier preserved until explicit compatibility decision.
amendments.proposed_text: For the PlasticOS commercial path, the query represents supplier-offered material and candidates are facilities eligible to buy/accept that material. Capability is evidence for fit, not proof of purchasing intent. Tests must distinguish supplier-only, buyer-only, dual-role, unknown and excluded facilities. Historic buyer-RFQ/supplier-facility prose is not the authority for the corrected business path.

amendments.preserve: Reverse candidates are active supply, never general facility capability.
amendments.proposed_text: Current supply requires admitted native-source lineage, explicit remaining quantity/units/time/marketability and maintained required graph relations. Hypotheses, expired/withdrawn facts and allocated quantities cannot satisfy confirmed demand. Result identity resolves to the originating native opportunity without name guessing.

amendments.section: Owner-controlled action registry and linked deployment policy
amendments.preserve: One semantic action owner, signed re-entry through Gate and caller node/kind/tenant scope.
amendments.proposed_text: The source-owner-approved gap operation, if newly required, is registered to CEG. Source projection grants are explicit and least-privilege; Odoo stays a consumer. A general match grant does not confer sync/gap permission. No role impersonation or new direct worker HTTP bypass. Update all declaration/admission/readiness tests against the same admitted registry revision.
